findings: November12 Kaguya quote explicitly confirms Tomegome surpassed him by0.01, matching known1:23.31→1:23.30; does not independently date1:23.39.
November14 early Kaguya reply thread says still stuck in1:23.30 range, bounding1:23.28 to a later interval before1:23.14 result; exact first publication remains unavailable.
Other November14 replies concern Mario Circuit1 theoretical laps, not Luigi1:23.28. Do not attach these laps or WR claims to Luigi.
